quote: Every motorcycle or moped when being driven on the highway is entitled to full use of the traffic lane it is occupying, and a person shall not drive another motor vehicle in a manner which would deprive any such motorcycle or moped of such use.

activation.condition: Protected motorcycle or moped being driven on a highway and occupying a traffic lane; subject drives another motor vehicle.

obligation.description: Do not drive in a manner that deprives the protected motorcycle or moped of full use of its occupied lane.

timing.description: While protected motorcycle or moped is being driven on the highway and occupies the traffic lane.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: full use of the traffic lane it is occupying
judgment_calls_needed.note: Original lane and vehicle footprints support independent review of full use; no numeric legal cutoff is supplied.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: deprive any such motorcycle or moped of such use
judgment_calls_needed.note: The manner of driving and deprivation require original motion, video, context, and independent legal judgment.
